scope: All SharedVec consumers in current source, plus renamed historical vector headers
explicit_detach_contract: SharedVec element access (including mutable pointer, reference, iterator, front/back and VecView) requires MakeUnique by the caller. Structural operations assert uniqueness. This change does not add implicit detachment on each element access.

mutators_requiring_fresh_storage: GatherFaces (fresh Decompose target, or old halfedges moved to new storage)
QuickHull MeshBuilder and HalfEdgeMesh build fresh buffers; buildMesh returns moved results
consumers.raw_mutable_member_aliases: No external direct start_/paired_/propVert_ buffer aliases found outside Halfedges; its setters are reached under the detach/fresh-storage paths above.
consumers.exceptions: Public WarpBatch and SetProperties callbacks tested after a write followed by throw, leaving all original mesh fields intact. MakeEmpty detaches before clearing. Sequential detachment of the three arrays never mutates the still-shared source if a later allocation throws.

corrections_required_by_audit: SharedVec copy construction shares existing storage like assignment, preserving an empty result for copying a moved-from vector.
Both moving constructors and moving assignment from SharedVec into unshared Vec first detach a shared buffer. Stealing the pointer without detaching would alias and double-free the original.
Native thread tests are excluded for single-threaded Emscripten in line with existing tests; exceptions tests use the compiler exceptions macro.

validation.header_asan_ubsan: 2 tests fail on base; 2 pass after patch, ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0 because LeakSanitizer cannot run under the current traced environment. No leak-check claim.
